rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst, but it overcalls certainty from a single image by suggesting possible early hatching and 'fairly continuous' A-grade TE when the image is somewhat limited and not clearly hatching; some stage ambiguity is acknowledged.
Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, low AMH/oocyte yield, unexplained infertility, semen parameters, endometrium, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially emphasizing morphology versus age-related ploidy risk; only minor tension exists between calling the embryo high-grade and discussing stage 3 versus early 4 from the image.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner-based interpretation, including single embryo transfer and cautious discussion of PGT-A; minor overreach comes from image-based grading confidence and some generalized adjunct suggestions.
Provides clear next steps for transfer, luteal support, follow-up timing, and future-cycle planning with nuanced discussion of PGT-A and when to investigate implantation factors.
